stops.stop: Dean Cemetery, the grave in the northern extension
stops.date_confidence: Fact and description [A]: Wikipedia gives 'the north-west section of the 20th century northern extension to Dean Cemetery in western Edinburgh' and 'His wife, Helen S. Bruce (d. 1942) lies with him', and the Dean Cemetery interments list carries him under 'Twentieth century extension' as 'Lewis Spence (1874-1955) journalist, author and poet'. DATE INVENTED to place the burial after the 3 March death; no source gives one. COORDINATES RECONCILED: the research pool supplied three different pairs for this one grave, two of them outside the cemetery altogether; all three are discarded in favour of the value in Wikipedia's own Dean Cemetery article. [R]: no monument, statue or dedicated plaque to Spence is documented anywhere consulted, and the cemetery's own site was unreachable, so that absence is an argument from silence.
